final: WITH g AS (SELECT GenreId AS genre_id, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS ratio_avg FROM Track GROUP BY GenreId), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio_avg) AS overall FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.avg_price, g.ratio_avg, g.ratio_avg - o.overall AS diff FROM g JOIN o ON g.ratio_avg > o.overall) SELECT AVG(avg_price), AVG(ratio_avg), AVG(diff) FROM k
